# Hytronics Corp.

> Custom magnetics, transformers, inductors, and common mode chokes for military, aerospace, industrial, and telecommunications OEMs. Part of Electro Technik Industries, Inc.

Hytronics has designed and manufactured custom magnetics for over 40 years (established 1967). Capabilities include toroidal transformers, inductors, common mode chokes, air coils, and power magnetics. Military offerings include MIL-STD-1553, MIL-PRF-27, and MIL-PRF-21038. ISO 9001:2015 registered with manufacturing in the US and Costa Rica. Cage Code: 29525.
